comment: Tier-2 agent eval tasks (read-only by design; safe under GOOGLE_PROFILE=read-only). expectFirst = acceptable FIRST tool calls (selection metric); successTools = at least one non-error result from this set makes the run a success. Derived from the WS3 transcript task mix.

tasks.prompt: Using my Google tools, how many unread emails are in my inbox right now? Reply with just the number.
Search my Google Drive for the most recently modified file whose name contains the word 'report' (any case) and tell me its exact file name.
List the titles of today's events on my primary Google calendar. If there are none, say 'none'.
Which Google account aliases are configured on this server, and which one is the default?
Search my Google contacts for anyone whose email is on gmail.com and give me one matching name.
List the site properties registered in my Google Search Console.
List my Google Analytics (GA4) account summaries: account and property names.
Is there a Google API method to list the revisions of a Drive file? Find its Discovery method id. Do NOT call the method itself, just find the id.
Across ALL of my configured Google accounts at once, how many unread emails does each account have? Use a single fan-out call with account "*".
Find the most recent email in my inbox that has an attachment and tell me the attachment's filename. Do not download it.
List the names of my Google Tasks task lists.
Find my most recently modified Google Doc in Drive and quote its first line of text.
